briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI release frontier models as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a new phase with multiple labs deploying advanced reasoning models. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical bottlenecks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced agentic capabilities while xAI launched Grok-3 achieving new benchmarks on ARC-AGI. Anthropic and Google DeepMind followed with Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime verification for autonomous agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 200k H100 cluster expansions. TSMC reports 3nm yield improvements benefiting NVIDIA's Blackwell ramp. Energy constraints slow new data center builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialects become mandatory for frontier deployments by 2027?
